title: BODY / FIT
purpose: Manage body-addressed fittings, purpose loadouts, source-distinct sensor observations and non-punitive RETURN/PATINA history over the shared BODY PLAN substrate without turning embodied/care state into a score.
kernel: BODY_ADDRESS -> FIT -> PREP -> SET_OUT -> SENSE -> RETURN -> PATINA -> NEXT_CUT

authority_split.body_fit: fitting identity/revision, body attachment address, local sensor-observation ledger and fusion projection
authority_split.open_twin: higher-resolution anatomical donor projection; personal registration remains an evidence obligation

fitting.law: revision creates a new fitting record with replaces/superseded_by; previous records are not overwritten

fusion.method: time-align observations by observed_property within a user-selected window; preserve one row per source

loadout.kit: snapshot current FITTED/ACTIVE fitting heads + purpose + optional loose prep items
loadout.prep: resolve saved fitting revisions against current heads; READY/UPDATED/PAUSED/MISSING remain visible; loose items are manually checked
loadout.session: SET OUT snapshots the exact kit + prep state; incomplete prep is allowed and remains evidence
loadout.return: RETURN + MARK stores what happened, one optional NEXT CUT, optional explicit latest BODY reference, and attached HOUSE context reference if present

patina.projection: deterministic virtual glyph per returned session; kit/config identity shapes the mark; checked loose items/body-ref/next-cut are visible features
patina.accumulation: monotonic history; gaps create no mark and no penalty

emotional_bridge.admission: explicit ATTACH LATEST BODY during an active loadout run only
emotional_bridge.purpose: reuse BODY's valence/activation/self-report lane without duplicating a second emotional scoring system

care_boundary.note: Loadout completion semantics may be useful for caregivers/pet care, but BODY / FIT does not mutate CARE cases or infer clinical improvement.

health_connect.law: Raw Health Connect export packets are transformed locally into existing observation envelopes; BODY / FIT remains the canonical browser-local observation ledger and never writes imported records back to Health Connect.
